description: This file defines models and logic for HR departments, user relationships, and window actions in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including classes for hr.department, ir_action_window, and res_users with associated methods and constraints.

classes.name: hr_department
classes.description: Model representing HR departments with hierarchy and membership management.

classes.name: ir_action_window
classes.description: Extension of window action to modify domain based on department members.

classes.name: res_users
classes.description: Extension of res.users to compute parent and child user relationships based on department memberships.

methods.name: _get_members
methods.description: Retrieve user IDs of department members managed by a specific user.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Check for recursive department hierarchy to prevent circular references.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Override to modify domain with department members in window actions.

methods.name: _parent_compute
methods.description: Compute parent users based on department memberships.

methods.name: _child_compute
methods.description: Compute child users based on department managers.

methods.name: _parent_search
methods.description: Search method for parent users based on department hierarchy.
